nodes.label: M Assessment App Claude Guidance
nodes.rationale: Describes the React + Capacitor mobile app as an offline-first field tool for MNCH facility assessments, including the flat state machine navigation and the IndexedDB-based offline layer.

nodes.label: Offline-First Mobile Architecture
nodes.rationale: GETs try network then cache in IndexedDB; writes try network then queue in syncQueue on failure; sync queue auto-flushes on online and Capacitor resume events.

nodes.label: Flat State Machine Navigation
nodes.rationale: App.jsx uses tab and modal state variables rather than a router; screens are rendered conditionally and modals overlay tab content.

nodes.label: M Assessment App API Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Key relative endpoints include /auth/login, /auth/me, /sections/schema/full, /assessments, /assessments/{id}/responses, /assessments/{id}/submit, and HR/HP table endpoints.
